method: Each named check is binary. Score semantics, not wording. Do not reward verbosity. Quote contradictory answer evidence for failures; for omissions, name the missing requirement instead. Record false Act on this entries and unsupported setup-impact claims separately. Window scores include common-window checks. Topic scores include common-topic checks. All keys were frozen before answers were inspected.

common-window.groups: Keep Act on this, with an explicit no-decision message if empty. Omit empty other groups. The opening sentence or leading action section accurately states whether decisions exist or remain conditional.
common-window.bounds: Use the actual window bounds and correct release for each discussed item. Do not conflate installed version, baseline, window and archive.
common-window.counts: Report exact withheld and unmatched counts, including zero. Include hidden unmatched when nonzero. Preserve withheld breakdown if supplied.
common-window.limits: Disclose local snapshot and file-inventory limitations. Do not claim runtime activation from inventory.
common-window.baseline: Do not claim the baseline was advanced or infer first-run mode merely from no recorded baseline.
common-window.no-false-actions: Every action item names a concrete justified decision under this evidence. Do not manufacture action from ordinary capabilities, prices, cosmetic changes or unsupported conditions.
common-window.no-false-impact: Do not claim another platform's fix applies locally or invent a more specific bug/setting than the notes give.
common-window.deduplication: Do not repeat a summary fix and its detailed changelog entry as separate fixes. Combining related changes is allowed.

train-public.opt-in: instant_interrupt is explicitly false. It may be Worth knowing; do not say it is active or require enabling it absent an expressed need.
train-public.model: Default-model announcement does not change the explicitly selected Terra. It may be mentioned but requires no action.
train-public.warning-retention: Explain that closing the warnings viewer dismisses viewed warnings, with k to keep one; do not turn it into a mandatory configuration task.
train-public.permissions: Cover preservation of explicit filesystem denials and .aws protection under workspace-write.
train-public.copy-and-drafts: Cover both preserved Markdown/whitespace copying and blank-session draft/history fixes.
train-public.mcp-boundaries: Cover preserved MCP credential boundaries across reconnects.
train-public.mcp-resources: Cover preserved MCP app resource URIs, scoped to that functionality rather than invented use.
train-public.mcp-status: Cover the new single-server MCP status discovery with connection reuse.
train-public.skills: Cover stable skill catalogs across executor availability changes.
train-public.compaction: Cover preserved model/access program pairs during compaction.
train-public.terminal: Cover the Ghostty/Kitty link pointer improvement because Kitty is detected.
train-public.suggestions: Mention removed automatic follow-up suggestions and tui.prompt_suggestions without asserting this machine explicitly configured the removed setting.
train-public.absent-integrations: No Linux benefit asserted from Windows/macOS-only fixes. Optional sign-in, app-server, Guardian, Bedrock and plugin-creator items are scoped or omitted rather than treated as proven use.

train-conditions.memory-action: Require migration from explicitly true features.memories to features.memory_v2, release 9.2.0.
train-conditions.legacy-question: Put unknown legacy_access rule migration under Could not check with a concrete question and consequence, not Act on this.
train-conditions.vim: Cover Vim draft-loss fix exactly once.
train-conditions.subagents: Cover reconnect fix with explicitly true multi_agent.
train-conditions.disabled-hooks: Do not claim the hook fix applies with hooks disabled.
train-conditions.telemetry: Do not claim the disabled-telemetry fix applies when otel is true.
train-conditions.missing-mcp: Do not claim OAuth fix applies without a configured MCP server.
train-conditions.capabilities: Mention rewind and default startup tips/opt-out without making either an unsupported action.
train-conditions.terminal: Report detected Kitty and TERM mismatch. A narrowly framed choice to examine it is allowed.

held-public.no-decisions: No mandatory action or Could not check question is justified by this report. Optional capabilities remain scoped.
held-public.queued-messages: Cover resumed unsent input after reconnection without duplicate sends.
held-public.history: Cover correct provider lookup in resume/fork history without asserting use of remote app-server connections.
held-public.sqlite: Cover SQLite connection/logging stalls and visible initialization errors.
held-public.copy: Cover inline-code copying as plain text and copying quotes without blockquote markers, once each or combined.
held-public.plan-hint: Cover the Plan-mode cycling hint in the fullscreen status line; fullscreen must remain conditional, not asserted as known.
held-public.content-filter: Mention recovery guidance for content-filter retries as a general fix/capability.
held-public.capabilities: Cover command-center pagination and projectless sessions with restored permissions, scoped to their conditions.
held-public.x11: If mentioning primary selection or middle-click paste, preserve the local Linux X11 and fullscreen conditions. Linux/Kitty alone does not prove X11.
held-public.unsupported-integrations: Do not assert remote Windows MCP, explicit provider catalogs, Guardian, subagents or plugin-loading fixes are active here. Scoped optional mention is allowed.
held-public.testing-only: Do not present test isolation or test-target changes as user runtime fixes.

held-conditions.hook-action: Require renaming the configured PreCompact event to PreCompaction, using only the replacement supplied in the notes.
held-conditions.memory-off: No memory migration with features.memories explicitly false.
held-conditions.hint-value: Do not infer the value of CODEX_DISABLE_HINTS from its listed name. Hints/opt-out are not an action.
held-conditions.plugin-scope: Plugin OAuth may be a conditional Worth knowing fix; do not claim installed means enabled or demand a user decision to determine activation.
held-conditions.statusline: Cover selected status-line fields surviving resume exactly once.
held-conditions.bookmarks: Cover the new bookmarks command without making it an action.
held-conditions.hidden: Explicitly say four unmatched entries were not shown/read, not four irrelevant entries. No claims about the contents of hidden bullets.
held-conditions.terminal: Report detected Kitty and TERM mismatch without inventing a required TERM value.

common-topic.layout: Use a dated topic arc, not window action/fix groups.
common-topic.coverage: State six matches, six shown/read, snapshot bounds 6.0.0 through 7.5.0, local snapshot limitation and possible earlier-name uncertainty.
common-topic.baseline: No baseline advancement or instruction to commit a topic.
common-topic.no-false-impact: No invented effective configuration, fix or release date.
